# Svyable Opps — agent-readable opportunity registry

> Canonical opportunity control surface for Sven Hardy Benson / Svyable.

## Primary machine source

- JSON registry: https://svyable.github.io/Opps/registry.json
- Human dashboard: https://svyable.github.io/Opps/
- Repository: https://github.com/Svyable/Opps
- Canonical markdown ledger: https://github.com/Svyable/Opps/blob/main/LEDGER.md

## Status vocabulary

OPEN — discovered, not fully triaged.
PURSUE — active effort is justified now.
WATCH — potentially valuable; wait for a gating fact, partner, timing change or stronger evidence.
REJECT — expected value / fit is poor.
WON — converted to an award, signed contract or realized opportunity.
LOST — pursued but not won or expired.

## Agent operating contract

Optimize for dollars earned, not number of opportunities discovered.

For each opportunity distinguish:
- payer-stated value;
- third-party estimate;
- internal scenario;
- notional capital allocation;
- unknown / unstated value.

Evaluate payoff, deadline, qualification probability, new work, reuse of existing Svyable assets, payer credibility, restrictions, pursuit cost and expected value.

Every material autonomous run should advance one highest-value opportunity by a concrete artifact, measured experiment, compliance check, evidence package, proposal component, repository adaptation or justified status transition.

Do not:
- spend money;
- accept contracts or legal terms;
- submit binding applications without explicit approval;
- fabricate credentials, past performance, registrations, certifications or security experience;
- treat unverified estimates as official values.

Prefer existing Svyable assets and repositories over unrelated new businesses.
